However, given the strict instruction to judge what is visible, the Router's verdict stands. The 'structural_collapse' on the right (Severity 2.5) is also critical; the `topology_boundary_auditor` mask shows a coherent main body but fails to resolve the right-side extension as a distinct, grounded entity, supporting the Router's observation of floating/merging geometry. The 'perspective_distortion' (Severity 1.5) is subtle but present in the warping of the bottom shelf edge. The Router did not miss any major artifacts, but the severity of the text issue is arguably higher (4.0) because *no* text is readable, which is unnatural for a close-up of books. I will adjust the artifact score to reflect this high-severity textual failure combined with structural ambiguity.

It is a valid bookcase, but the image does not fully demonstrate all class-defining features due to cropping and lack of detail.
